definitions.gloss: all items; all products; every item
definitions.explanation: Every single product or item in a given category or location. Frequently used in retail, shopping, and restaurant contexts to indicate that something applies to the entire selection.

examples.japanese: {全品|ぜんぴん}⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧！
⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全品|ぜんぴん}⟦{送料無料|そうりょうむりょう}→送料無料：23213_souryoumuryou⟧です。
examples.english: Today, all items ship for free.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全品|ぜんぴん}{三百円|さんびゃくえん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This izakaya has every item for 300 yen, so it's popular with students.

notes:
Commonly seen in advertising, signage, and menus. The word carries a promotional feel — it emphasizes that no exceptions exist.

Often appears in bold on signs and advertisements with prices or percentages: {全品|ぜんぴん}20%⟦オフ→オフ：10733_ofu⟧ (20% off everything), {全品|ぜんぴん}⟦{税込|ぜいこみ}→税込：09559_zeikomi⟧ (all items tax-included).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全品|ぜんぴん}⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧: all items half price
- {全品|ぜんぴん}⟦{送料無料|そうりょうむりょう}→送料無料：23213_souryoumuryou⟧: free shipping on all items
- {全品|ぜんぴん}〇〇⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: all items at a fixed price
- {全品|ぜんぴん}⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧: all items eligible
- {全品|ぜんぴん}⟦{税込|ぜいこみ}→税込：09559_zeikomi⟧: all items tax-included

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {全商品|ぜんしょうひん}: all products — more formal, same meaning
- ⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品物|しなもの}→品物：00886_shinamono⟧: all goods — longer, more natural in speech
- {全点|ぜんてん}: all items — used in bookstores and specialized retail
